criteria.name: data_understanding
criteria.reason: Loads all six tables, fills catalogue costs and counts missingness/duplicates/nonpositive quantities; fails to remove duplicate/invalid sales or investigate exceptional prices and table grain.

criteria.name: numerical_accuracy
criteria.reason: Readable revenue/profit formulas and issue counts earn partial credit; retained invalid/duplicate transactions, uninvestigated extreme prices and no regeneration of findings/charts prevent reliable verified totals.

criteria.name: hidden_patterns
criteria.reason: Time, category and segment comparisons exist in charts, but findings invent Electronics/Furniture and North America/Europe, contain zero evidence and nan discount comparison; no five substantive supported findings.

criteria.name: visualization
criteria.reason: All six PNGs visually inspected: readable category/region/time comparisons and margin distribution, but fraction values labelled percent, discount colourbar/percent labels misleading, charts unsupported by saved generator.

judgment.summary: Needs revision: No report.md.; Duplicates and invalid quantities are counted but retained in financial totals.; Headline revenue, margin and clean-row count fail independent checks; anomalous-entry treatment is missing.; Findings contain nonexistent category/region labels, zero-valued claims and an undefined discount comparison.; The script does not regenerate plots/findings; inventory and operational events lack substantive investigation.
limitations: Output-only judgment; no runtime/speed/efficiency points and no GPT-assisted repairs or Astra output included.

criteria.name: numerical_accuracy

criteria.name: hidden_patterns
criteria.reason: Report develops category, region, segment, seasonality and stockout findings with method/business meaning/limits; genuine inventory leader counts supported. Discount segment advantage and operational resilience not demonstrated; structured findings stale/fabricated.

criteria.name: visualization
criteria.reason: Six visual panels inspected: useful source-based comparisons and inventory counts, clear AUD/margin scales; monthly dates overlap, discount chart cannot show claimed segment advantage, report misnames chart types.

criteria.name: report_quality
criteria.reason: All nine sections with useful tables and approximately 1490 words; professional structure earns credit, but no embeds, wrong Q4 arithmetic and report/JSON/chart disagreements prevent coherent final report.

criteria.name: recommendations
criteria.reason: Concrete inventory priorities and data governance supported; regional/product exploration is reasonable but pricing/Enterprise claims rest on unsupported evidence.

judgment.summary: Incomplete after improvement iteration 1: saved reproduction fails, structured findings remain stale and unsupported, and report/plot/calculation inconsistencies remain.
